content:
I am pleased to share that I have successfully completed my internship at NyayaSarthak under the guidance of Advocate Manik Goyal , 
Supreme Court of India from 1st July 2026 to 30th July 2026.
This internship, provided me an opportunity to work on real legal assignments that strengthened both my legal research and drafting skills. My work included:
1. Drafting of legal notice under NI Act
2. Drafting of DV petition
3. Written arguments in a Constitutional Law matter
4. Drafting of Sale Deed
